newsitem.title: UK: Bruce keeps Treasury job for UK Liberal Democrats.
newsitem.headline: Bruce keeps Treasury job for UK Liberal Democrats.

text.p: Malcolm Bruce remains the chief Treasury spokesman in the British parliament for the minority Liberal Democrats in a division of responsibilities announced on Monday by party leader Paddy Ashdown.

Bruce will be supported by two new MPs -- Edward Davey, the member for Kingston and Surbiton who acted as economics adviser to the Liberal Democrat MPs between 1989 and 1993, and Jenny Tonge, the member for Richmond Park.
The Liberal Democrats won 46 seats at the May 1 election, becoming the largest third force in the British parliament for more than 60 years. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
